claims.evidence: Witness report describes a light grey/cream insulated bag with embossed logo/text reading BENNY'SCHOOL; no clear evidence of 'HP Power' in the provided observations.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened
claims.evidence: Witness says the bag appears used but intact; no visible tears. Photo does not confirm 'never repaired' or 'never opened'.
Photo shows it is intact, but zipper smoothness, insulation performance, and interior condition are not shown.
No receipt/warranty documents are shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch (seller says 'HP Power' but visible logo appears 'BENNY'SCHOOL'), which affects the correct replacement/market value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the exact brand name and any model/variant label (front logo and any inner tag/label).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used insulated lunch bag with uncertain brand/variant.

risks.risk: Condition uncertainty: 'like new' may be overstated; photo only confirms no obvious tears, not interior lining, stains, odors, or zipper condition.
risks.proof: Open the bag fully and photograph the interior lining, all zippers (close-up of teeth and track), and any seams for stains/repairs.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for a used bag with possible interior wear (as not fully verified).

risks.risk: Hidden damage not visible: insulation panels, mesh/nylon panel integrity, and stitching near corners may be damaged without obvious tears.
risks.proof: Photograph the side mesh/nylon panel and bottom-corner compartment seams from multiple angles, plus a close-up of stitching.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially imperfect/with hidden wear.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (e.g., straps/attachments, changing mat, extra compartments) that could change value.
risks.proof: A photo showing everything included laid out (bag + any accessories) and a checklist of included items.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the bag is included.

risks.risk: Warranty/receipt may not be available or may not match the item, affecting buyer confidence.
risks.proof: Photos of the receipt and warranty card/serial details that match the bag’s brand/model.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the exact brand name and any model/variant label (front logo and any inner tag).
Open the bag and photograph the interior lining, including any stains/odors, and close-ups of zipper tracks and smooth operation.
Close-up photos of seams/stitching and the side mesh/nylon panel and bottom-corner compartment area.
Photos of all included accessories laid out (if any), and confirm whether any straps/attachments are present and functional.
Photos of the receipt and warranty card/serial details that match the bag.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as an insulated lunch bag and the photo suggests it is intact, so a worst-case used price is possible. However, brand/condition/warranty details are not fully verifiable from the report, so it should be priced conservatively until the requested proof is provided.
